title: Triton-Kernel Autotuning for Sparse Attention at Scale
venue_full: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems
summary: Sparse attention kernels dominate long-context inference cost. We autotune Triton kernels against a PyTorch reference path, profile occupancy and memory traffic on Kubernetes inference pools, and keep the tuning harness in Python. The winning configurations cut time-to-first-token by 38% on production traffic while holding numerics within tolerance.
